messages:
mei (newhire): hi team, first morning trying to reach internal CI webhooks at ci.internal.redwood but the webhook callback from our test job fails. i'm on WG split-tunnel and the client shows connected. any ideas? :wave:

samir: welcome! quick check - can you `curl -v http://ci.internal.redwood/health` from your laptop and post the output? also are you on office wifi or home?

mei (newhire): office wifi. curl shows DNS resolves to 10.12.9.7 but `connect to 10.12.9.7 port 80 failed: Connection refused`. wg handshake looks recent in `wg show`.

infra-oncall: try `ssh -J ec2-user@bastion-us-east-1 ec2-user@ci.internal.redwood` to see if bastion can reach it. also `nc -vz 10.12.9.7 80` from bastion.

mei (newhire): ssh to bastion works, `nc -vz` from bastion says connection refused too.

jules: if bastion sees connection refused it's probably a service or SG issue. which CI cluster? can you list the hostname exactly?

mei (newhire): looks like `ci-infra-us-east-1`.

samir: checking infra console... I see we rotated WireGuard dev peer ranges last night as part of the scheduled rotate. The CI service SG only allowed the older peer range and a couple specific bastion ENIs. New peers weren't added to the allowed-sources list. That would make the service refuse connections from new WG peers (and some newer bastions).

infra-oncall: temporary fix — adding the new dev WG peer CIDR 10.60.0.0/18 to the CI SG for 1 hour so you can test.

ops-bot: Ticket NET-9980 created for mei (newhire): "CI webhook unreachable - WG peer rotation missing in SG".

mei (newhire): after the SG update curl now gets 200 OK. thanks! :tada:

samir: great. follow-ups: we'll add the new peer CIDRs to the CI SG permanently and add a post-rotation checklist so future rotates don't leave services unreachable. also update onboarding docs to mention WG peer rotations and who to ping.

jules: can you open a tiny docs PR noting the rotate gotcha and the quick test `curl` + `ssh -J` steps you used? puts it in /docs/onboarding/network.md under "first-day checks".

mei (newhire): yep i can do that, will include the `wg show` snippet and curl output. thanks for the help everyone!

infra-oncall: filed CHORE ENGINF-3344: "add dev-wg peer CIDRs to CI SG + rotation checklist" and linked NET-9980.

ops-bot: CHORE ENGINF-3344 created and linked to NET-9980.

samir: adding this to the onboarding checklist so new hires run the CI webhook test on day 1. :white_check_mark:
